question: Find the display name of the user who owns the most popular post (highest view count) among posts that have exactly one comment, were created in 2014, and have at least one related post link. Additionally, list all badge names earned by this user in the same year without duplicates,sorted by the name of the badges.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_posts AS (
    SELECT
        p.XCL_026 AS post_id,
        p.XCL_033 AS owner_user_id,
        p.XCL_030 AS view_count
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2014'
      AND p.XCL_026 IN (
          SELECT c.XCL_006
          FROM comments AS c
          GROUP BY c.XCL_006
          HAVING COUNT(c.XCL_005) = 1
      )
      AND p.XCL_026 IN (
          SELECT pl.XCL_023
          FROM postLinks AS pl
      )
),
top_user AS (
    SELECT
        u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
        u.XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM qualifying_posts AS qp
    INNER JOIN users AS u ON qp.owner_user_id = u.XCL_052
    ORDER BY qp.view_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    tu.display_name,
    b.XCL_003 AS badge_name
FROM top_user AS tu
INNER JOIN badges AS b ON tu.user_id = b.XCL_002
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2014'
GROUP BY tu.display_name, b.XCL_003
ORDER BY b.XCL_003 ASC

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH qualifying_posts AS (
    SELECT
        p.XCL_026 AS post_id,
        p.XCL_033 AS owner_user_id,
        p.XCL_030 AS view_count
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2014'
      AND p.XCL_026 IN (
          SELECT c.XCL_006
          FROM comments AS c
          GROUP BY c.XCL_006
          HAVING COUNT(c.XCL_005) = 1
      )
      AND p.XCL_026 IN (
          SELECT pl.XCL_023
          FROM postLinks AS pl
      )
),
top_user AS (
    SELECT
        u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
        u.XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM qualifying_posts AS qp
    INNER JOIN users AS u ON qp.owner_user_id = u.XCL_052
    ORDER BY qp.view_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    tu.display_name,
    b.XCL_003 AS badge_name
FROM top_user AS tu
INNER JOIN badges AS b ON tu.user_id = b.XCL_002
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2014'
GROUP BY tu.display_name, b.XCL_003
ORDER BY b.XCL_003 ASC

    SELECT
        p.XCL_026 AS post_id,
        p.XCL_033 AS owner_user_id,
        p.XCL_030 AS view_count
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2014'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM comments AS c
          WHERE c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
          GROUP BY c.XCL_006
          HAVING COUNT(c.XCL_005) = 1
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM postLinks AS pl
          WHERE pl.XCL_023 = p.XCL_026
      )
),
top_user AS (
    SELECT
        u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
        u.XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM qualifying_posts AS qp
    INNER JOIN users AS u ON qp.owner_user_id = u.XCL_052
    ORDER BY qp.view_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    tu.display_name,
    b.XCL_003 AS badge_name
FROM top_user AS tu
INNER JOIN badges AS b ON tu.user_id = b.XCL_002

WITH qualifying_posts AS (
    SELECT
        p.XCL_033 AS user_id,
        p.XCL_039 AS view_count
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN comments c ON p.XCL_026 = c.XCL_006
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2014'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM postLinks pl
          WHERE pl.XCL_023 = p.XCL_026
      )
    GROUP BY p.XCL_026
    HAVING COUNT(c.XCL_006) = 1
),
top_user AS (
    SELECT
        u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
        u.XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM qualifying_posts qp
    INNER JOIN users u ON qp.user_id = u.XCL_052
    ORDER BY qp.view_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    tu.display_name,
    b.XCL_003 AS badge_name
FROM top_user tu
INNER JOIN badges b ON tu.user_id = b.XCL_002
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2014'
ORDER BY b.XCL_003 ASC
